name: HostWatch
shortDescription: Read-only endpoint observation: scoped file facts, process metadata, evidence-backed review alerts.
features: Mockable collector interface (psutil when available; unsupported features reported)
Explicit watch scope; missing paths marked explicitly
Optional SHA-256 file facts; change detection across observations
Read-only by design: never terminates processes or modifies files
Alerts carry evidence and honest disclaimers
knownLimitations: Command lines not collected (may contain secrets) — documented
No filesystem event streaming yet (polling observations)
